svg.title: 264 MOTS-c papers on PubMed. None gave it to a person.
svg.desc: Jabbit classification of 264 PubMed records for MOTS-c, retrieved October 16, 2026: 100 gave MOTS-c to animals or cells, 84 measured natural MOTS-c or its gene variant in people, 78 reviews and commentary, 2 off-topic, and 0 gave MOTS-c to a person.
